entry.name: Bittrees Bounties
entry.description: Token-funded bounties for builders with milestone proposals, delivery evidence, and ERC-20 escrow. Visitors can browse public builder profiles.

history.reason: The official site documents token-funded bounties and ERC-20 escrow. The public builder profiles load at https://bounties.bittrees.org/profiles, and this product has a distinct directory entry and website.

entry.name: Bittrees Capital
entry.description: Public dashboard for Bittrees token distribution, treasury holdings, and onchain Safe controls. Its holder view shows how balances are distributed.

history.reason: The official Capital dashboard and https://capital.bittrees.org/holders are public. The holder view supports the listing description of Bittrees token distribution and makes this distinct from the general Bittrees entry.

entry.name: Bittrees Research
entry.description: Research collaboration workspace with Ethereum-linked membership and contributor credentials. Its public overview explains how research requests are proposed, reviewed, and completed.
